## Merge gate

The `checklist` check fails until every box below is ticked. Tick a box only when it is true. For a pull request from
outside the team, a maintainer runs the reviews and ticks the boxes.

- [ ] **Simplify** run on the final diff; fixes applied or noted below
- [ ] **Code review** run on the final diff; no open blocking findings
- [ ] **Security review** run on the final diff; no open findings
- [ ] **Tests** cover what this PR adds or changes, main and secondary paths (or: no behaviour change)
